about_the_game:
"Video Editing Pro" is your ultimate companion for creating, editing, and cutting videos — whether you're a content creator, filmmaker, or casual editor. Packed with powerful features and an intuitive interface, it makes professional-grade editing accessible to everyone.

Edit, Cut & Create With Ease

Quickly cut, splice, and arrange your clips across multiple tracks with intuitive drag-and-drop. Mix videos and audio of various formats effortlessly on the same timeline.

Format Variety

The editor supports a wide range of modern video, audio, and image formats and codecs. Easily convert and export your project to your desired output format - optimized for YouTube, streaming, or archiving.

Assemble & Pre-Cut

Organize your media in a dedicated library and prepare clips before placing them on the timeline.

Record & Capture

Capture your screen, applications, or games directly within the software using the built-in screen recording tool — perfect for tutorials, gameplay, or presentations.

Effects, Filters & Transitions

Enhance your visuals with a rich collection of professional-grade video and audio effects, transitions, blend modes, and adjustable filters to give your content a unique look.

Animate with Keyframes

Add dynamics and motion to filters, effects and parameters with powerful keyframe animations.

Clean, Modern Interface

A sleek, user-friendly interface designed for speed and clarity. Customize your workspace and workflow to fit your style, whether you're a hobbyist or seasoned editor.

Whether you're making YouTube videos, streaming highlights, documentaries, or cinematic content, "Video Editing Pro" puts professional video editing at your fingertips.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX9 / DirectX11 / OpenGL 2.0 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX9 / DirectX11 / OpenGL 2.0 compatible GPU with 8 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Soundcard
